The code review and local checks are clean. The PR conflicts with current main. Refresh the branch before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I read the complete diff and the linked issues #3917 and #3830.
I checked the project laws from `upstream/main:AGENTS.md` at `3593a61235bc0f5d9ad0ec9dc9e0526c67ed45e7`.
There is no earlier review on this PR.

What looks good:

- Each eligible ring uses the entry path when the pass link cannot keep down.
- The crossing uses the pass link plane. The keep-down proof runs before the new entry.
- The pins cover Ramp, Helix, Plunge, several parts, and the Clearance and Retract pass links.
- No UI, dependency, process, fixture, or recorded program changed. No goldens moved.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs:304` and `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_step.rs:48`: merge current main and resolve the code conflicts. Main adds `Step::uncut`, `uncut_floor`, and pecked tab dives from #3678. Retain those changes together with `Step::traverse` and the ring entry. The import block and tab-window call also conflict in `contour.rs:16` and `contour.rs:312`. Run the targeted gate on the resolved head.

Local trial merge:
```
git merge --no-edit upstream/main
CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs
CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_step.rs
Automatic merge failed; fix conflicts and then commit the result.
```
I aborted the trial merge without resolving code. No merge commit exists, so the `HEAD^1` check is not possible.
All results below apply to the unmerged PR head `77b71f78b216efea67651394267e860eff081877`.
They do not verify integration with current main. No GitHub runner was used.

Refreshed for merge: merged main d4601c6ea into the branch. The new head is 6228a545e. This is a merge commit. There is no rebase and no force-push.

**What conflicted**

Main has PR #3866 (#3678). This PR has #3917. The two sides changed the same code:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs`: the `use` lines, the `Step` literal, and the tab window dive.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_step.rs`: `Step` got a new field on each side (`traverse` on this PR, `uncut` on main).

**How it was reconciled (by hand)**

- `Step` keeps the two fields. `emit_band` sets `traverse` from `ring_entry` (#3917) and `uncut` from `uncut_floor(p, rz, rzi)` (#3678).
- This PR moved the tab window dive into `contour_link::tab_window_dive`. Main changed the same dive in `contour.rs` to peck through `contour_peck::dive`. The helper now takes `uncut` and calls `contour_peck::dive` with the same arguments as main. Thus the tab window dive pecks as on main, and `contour.rs` stays near 400 lines.
- A ring after another one at the same level now goes to `engage_level` (#3917). Where that ends in `graze`, the dive pecks by `s.uncut` (#3678). Thus each wall-side ring gets the stated entry, and a deep plunge below the first level still pecks.
- No test of either side changed. Each pinning test of the two sides is kept.

**Tests (debug, on 6228a545e)**

- `camcraft-motion`: `machining2d` (76), `contour_inside_ramp`, `contour_tab_entry`, `control_comp`, `wear_comp`, `contour_tabs`, `contour_tab_lead`, `contour_tab_bridge`, `contour_tab_height`, `contour_tab_necks`, `contour_start`, `contour_start_comp`, `contour_auto_side`, `contour_whole`, `contour_whole_new_outline`, `contour_whole_no_floor`, `contour_outside_floor`, and the lib tests `machining2d` (includes `contour_peck`). All pass.
- `camcraft-app`: `plunge_depth_tab`, `example_catalog` (41 pass, 4 heavy not run), `example_catalog_edge_work`, `contour_outside_hole`, `contour_whole_step`, `contour_none_lead`, `contour_open_side`, `contour_auto_level`, `contour_stock_run`, `contour_start_point`, `contour_dxf_profiles`. All pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Review**

The resolution has hand edits in safety code. It is class DELTA. It needs a delta review of the remerge-diff (`git show --remerge-diff 6228a545e`) at the safety tier (Opus). The PR stays a draft.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This is a re-review at the SAFETY tier. The PR changes posted motion (the 2D Contour entry and the ring-to-ring link).
The new head `6228a545e` is the old head `77b71f78b` plus one merge of main `d4601c6ea`. The merge has hand edits (class DELTA).
I read the complete diff against main again, and the remerge-diff (`git show --remerge-diff 6228a545e`) line by line.
I checked the laws against `upstream/main:AGENTS.md` at `d4601c6ea`.

### Earlier finding (review of `77b71f78b`)

1. The merge conflicts with main in `contour.rs` and `contour_step.rs`: **fixed** by the merge commit `6228a545e`. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`. A local `git merge upstream/main` says "Already up to date".

There was no other finding.

### Delta review of the conflict resolution

- `Step` keeps the two fields: `traverse` (#3917) and `uncut` (#3678). `emit_band` sets `uncut` from `uncut_floor(p, rz, rzi)`, as main does (`contour.rs:306`).
- `contour_link::tab_window_dive` now takes `uncut` and calls `contour_peck::dive` with the same arguments as main (`contour_link.rs:278-285`). The moves before it (feed up, rapid across, `guard`) are the same as on main.
- The `use` lines are the union of the two sides. `contour_peck::dive` is no longer used in `contour.rs`, so its import is correctly removed.
- A ring after another ring now goes to `engage_level`. Where that ends in `graze`, the dive pecks by `s.uncut`. Before, `ring_link` plunged straight to the level. The new path is not less safe than the path of main.
- No test of main or of the PR changed in the merge.
- `contour.rs` has 402 lines. Main has 402 lines also. The file does not grow.

### Results, merged with main (locally, macOS, no GitHub runner)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 43 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
  - motion: 29 steps, 913 passed, 0 failed, 23 ignored. This includes `lib` (629), `machining2d` (76), `contour_inside_ramp` (6), `contour_tab_entry` (5), `contour_tabs` (5), `level_links`, `one_descent`, `control_comp` and `wear_comp`.
  - app: 14 steps, 93 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored (heavy). This includes `example_catalog` (41 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` (1), `example_catalog_edge_work` (1), `solid_law_goldens`, `wall_arc_entry`, `arc_entry`, `contour_none_lead`, `first_part_programs` and `first_router_part`.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Extra suites run:

- `camcraft-app --test plunge_depth_tab`: 2 passed. This is the #3678 / #3925 pin of main for the pecked tab window dive. The quick gate did not select it, and the merge resolution changes that dive.
- `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` and `solid_law_goldens`: in the quick gate above.
- The diff changes no fixture directory and no importer. The STEP and mesh suites do not apply.

Goldens: no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file is in the diff. The body says "None", and that is correct.

Heavy lanes: not run. They are not a merge condition for this `P3` PR, and no record names this head.

### Mutations (run on `6228a545e`, each restored after)

1. `contour.rs:252`: `ring_to_ring && inside && !tabbed` put back at the `ring_entry` call. Result: RED. `every_outside_ring_of_several_parts_is_entered_by_the_wall_side_ramp` fails (`left: 3`, `right: 0`).
2. `contour_link.rs:284`: `tab_window_dive` passes `None` and not `uncut` to `contour_peck::dive`. Result: RED. `contour_tab_entry` has 4 failures, `machining2d::tabs_hold_the_part_until_the_floor` fails, and `plunge_depth_tab` has 2 failures.
3. `contour.rs:306`: `Step { .. uncut: None }`. Result: RED. `contour_tab_entry` has 2 failures (`no_contour_descent_goes_more_than_one_stepdown_below_the_disc_floor` is one) and `tabs_hold_the_part_until_the_floor` fails.

After the restore, the worktree is clean at `6228a545e`, and the three suites pass again.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Notes for the merging session (not blocking)

- This PR contains the two commits of #3834 (`f7e70460f`, `4113f66d0`). #3834 is open, is a draft, conflicts with main and has `needs-rework` from the review of its older head. Its head `4113f66d0` has no review of its own. This review read that code as part of the complete diff, and its pins (`contour_inside_ramp`, 6 passed) are green here.
- The commit `f7e70460f` ends with `Fixes #3830`. Thus a merge of this PR closes #3830 also.
- The body says "Merge #3834 first". If this PR merges first, main gets the #3834 code with it, and #3834 has nothing more to add. Decide the order (or close #3834 as included) before the merge.
- The "Tests" section of the body gives the counts of the old head. The comment "Refreshed for merge" has the counts of the new head. My counts above agree with that comment.
- No UI changed, so no screenshots are necessary.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

left for the maintainer: the only `pr-reviewer` marker at this head (`6228a545e`) is by the PR author (mkinney), which does not count; no clean collaborator review by an agent that did not write the change. The PR is also stacked on #3834 (still open, `needs-rework`), so it must not merge before #3834. It changes contour entry geometry, so the safety step is a human check.
